source.title: Hope Begins in the Dark
source.description:
Naxxramas poses a threat like nothing you've faced before. It is the seat of Kel'Thuzad's power, and contains horrors unknown to even the most battle-scarred among the Argent Dawn.

Take this seal.

When you venture within the necropolis, you carry the weight of our hopes, <name>. It's only right that you also carry our strength.
source.objective: Receive the Seal of the Dawn.
source.completion:
This Seal will empower the equipment you recover from inside Naxxramas.

Keep it close and use it well.
